title: Pokkiri Raja
desc: Raja takes the blame for a murder committed by his father and is deserted by him. Years later, his father comes seeking his help when his younger brother, Surya, is falsely imprisoned.

title: Arrambam
desc: Ashok, a former member of the ATS, along with Arjun, a computer hacker, and his girlfriend Anitha, tries to unveil a scam involving the bulletproof jackets provided to police officers.

title: Anjaan
desc: Krishna travels to Mumbai to look for his missing brother Raju. However, things take a turn when he learns that Raju was a notorious gangster in the city.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.

title: Comali
desc: A long coma leaves Ravi disorientated in an unrecognisable world. However, he sets out on a journey to reclaim his past and adapt to a new reality.
